formal_attempt.failure_behavior: Complete every registered control and both hard/soft panels unless an engineering blocker prevents complete evidence.
formal_attempt.resume: A durable create-only resume may finish missing cells after infrastructure interruption only with identical source, inputs, folds, draws, gates, and existing artifacts; it is not a new attempt.

hard_stop: After the validation report and publication receipt commits are pushed and exact remote SHAs are verified, stop for independent review.
input_scope: Only the complete frozen Gate1C regenerated-B0 private bundle, exact nine B0 stage-best checkpoints, frozen data roles, and the public V0.1 diagnostic status bound in preregistration.
prohibited: modification of historical reports, statuses, archives, formal runs, bundles, checkpoints, manifests, splits, or checksums
preregistration_binding: No descriptor, memory, fold, solve, selection, control, bootstrap, aggregation, gate, blocker, output, or isolation rule may be amended during execution.
